name: Press to Gather - Configurable

upstream.name: Toggleable Auto Gather - Press to Gather
upstream.author: Tic0311

customization: Configurable controller button, default B/Circle held 0.6s; Mod Settings distance 10-200m in 10m steps, default 20m; native input lifecycle and bounded actor batches
shared_dependency: SettingsStore from ue4ss-common; exact commit, hashes and license pinned in ue4ss-common.lock.json

distribution.basis: Upstream Nexus permissions permit credited modifications and redistribution. Sales are prohibited; Donation Points require separate permission.
distribution.scope: Personal mod; original rights retained. The bundled shared module has its own MIT license.

liveSettings.startup: Prepare missing preferences once; do not activate gameplay effects.
liveSettings.callback: Validate committed numeric values, preserve file-only keys, merge pending changes and update affected runtime state. No configuration I/O or polling.
